def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None, subevent=None):
    return CartPosition(
        item=item, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
        used_membership=membership, subevent=subevent,
    )


@pytest.fixture
def plain_ticket(event):
    return Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Ticket', default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_membership_required(event, customer, plain_ticket):
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, plain_ticket)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event, lock=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_required_but_missing(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)], event)
    assert 'requires an active membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_without_customer(event, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)], event)
    assert 'requires an active membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_membership_not_for_product(event, customer, membership, plain_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, plain_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'does not require a membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_other_customer(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(other, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'different customer account' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_canceled(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.canceled = True
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'has been canceled' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_test_mode_mismatch(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.testmode = True
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event, testmode=False)
    assert 'not in test mode' in excinfo.value.message

    membership.testmode = False
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event, testmode=True)
    assert 'add a test mode membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_type_not_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Other")
    membership.membership_type = other_type
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'is not allowed for the product' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_expired_for_event(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'taking place at' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen_ignores_event_date(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    membership.date_end += timedelta(days=200)
    membership.save()
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event,
                                  valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen_ended(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        membership.date_end = now() - timedelta(days=1)
        membership.save()
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event,
                                      valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_in_batch(event, customer, membership, membership_type, requiring_ticket):
    membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership_type.save()
    positions = [
        _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, subevent=None),
        _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, subevent=None),
    ]
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, positions, event)
    assert 'maximum amount' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_counts_existing_orders(event, customer, membership, membership_type, requiring_ticket):
    membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership_type.save()
    order = Order.objects.create(
        event=event, email='old@example.org', status=Order.STATUS_PAID, datetime=now(), expires=now(),
        total=Decimal('23.00'), locale='en', sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        customer=customer,
    )
    order.positions.create(item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership, attendee_name_parts={})
    cart = [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)]
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, cart, event)
    assert 'maximum amount' in excinfo.value.message
    # Usages of the order that is being changed do not count against it
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, cart, event, ignored_order=order)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage_in_batch(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    positions = [
        _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership),
        _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership),
    ]
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, positions, event)
    assert 'at the same time' in excinfo.value.message

    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, positions, event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    order = Order.objects.create(
        event=event, email='old@example.org', status=Order.STATUS_PAID, datetime=now(), expires=now(),
        total=Decimal('23.00'), locale='en', sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        customer=customer,
    )
    order.positions.create(item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership, attendee_name_parts={})
    cart = [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)]
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, cart, event)
    assert 'at the same time' in excinfo.value.message
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, cart, event, ignored_order=order)
